header: GET /api/announcements/<id>/page/<n> the picture (PNG) of page n of an announcement's PDF, as the search index kept it (the circulars keep theirs the same way). I keep this open to whoever may read the announcements (they are public on the home page). The address of the picture in Vercel Blob never leaves the server: this route fetches it and passes the bytes on. A page that has no picture (the PDF was not prepared for the search bar, or that page's picture was not kept), or a database with no such table yet, gets a 404.
